No separation is required between nonseparated occupancies.
   Exceptions:
      1.   Group H-2, H-3, H-4 and B-5 occupancies shall be separated from all other occupancies in accordance with Section 508.4.
      2.   Separated tenancies in accordance with Section 510.10.
      3.   Commercial kitchens shall be separated in accordance with Section 508.1, Exception 5.

 3. Commercial kitchens shall be separated in accordance with Section 508.1, Exception 5.
